import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000007L;
    static final int mxN = 1000000007;

    static long nod(long a, long b) {
        if (b > a) {
            long temp = a;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
        while (b > 0) {
            long temp = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long nok(long a, long b) {
        return a * b / nod(a, b);
    }

    static void sp(int a, double b) {
        System.out.printf("%." + a + "f", b);
    }

    static long binpow(long a, long n) {
        if (n == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            return binpow(a, n - 1) * a;
        } else {
            long b = binpow(a, n / 2);
            return b * b;
        }
    }

    static void solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw) {
        String s = sc.next();
        boolean ok = false;
        int length = s.length();
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            if (i + 1 < length && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && !ok && i != 0 && (i + 1) != length - 1) {
                ok = true;
                pw.print('@');
                i++;
            } else if (i + 2 < length && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && i != 0 && (i + 2) != length - 1) {
                pw.print('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                pw.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        pw.println();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        // int t = sc.nextInt(); // Not used, as in original code
        int t = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < t; i++) {
            solve(sc, pw);
        }
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
